text:
sofia: quick idea: run network preflight before secrets step so users fail fast. mock: https://figma.com/s/preflight-v2
ken: yes — cut support churn. add a single-line explainer: 'We run quick network checks to save setup time.' link to docs.
mariah: copy: drop 'allowlist' -> 'Allowed IP ranges'. show a sample CIDR `10.0.0.0/24`. keep language terse.
gary: real note: public IP autodetect fails behind NAT. add an explicit 'I have a public IP' checkbox and a short NAT troubleshooting CTA.
sofia: layout question: inline accordion vs side drawer for the checks? I prefer inline so users don't lose context.
ken: a11y: accordion headers must be buttons with aria-expanded. announce failures with role=alert. also don't rely on color only for status.
mariah: failure text should be short and actionable: 'Connectivity check failed. Try: <step 1>, <step 2>'. no long paragraphs.
preflight-bot: running checks...
preflight-bot: ```
DNS_RESOLVE: OK
OUTBOUND_443: WARN (handshake 420ms)
CIDR_ROUTE: FAIL (no route to 10.1.0.0/16)
TLS_VERIFY: OK
```
gary: show per-check remediation inline (small expandable row) rather than dumping everything below. include example command for AWS/GCE/on-prem.
sofia: show 'Advanced diagnostics' collapsed by default with raw traceroute/curl and a copy button.
ken: dev ask: please have API return structured checks array: [{id, status, message, remediation_url, raw_output_url}]. makes rendering straightforward.
mariah: keyboard flow: after run, focus goes to first failing check and screen reader reads the failure headline.
sofia: accessibility color nit: our amber doesn't meet contrast for body text. either darken or add icon/label.
gary: add short error codes for triage (e.g., PREFLT_03_CIDR). include in UI and logs.
sofia: final decision: inline accordion, per-check inline remediation, collapsed advanced logs, explicit public IP checkbox, and updated copy suggestions. i'll push spec and copy by EOD. :thumbsup:
